import { defineTable, col, rel } from "@rebasepro/server/schema";
import { film } from "./film";

// Introspected as a lookup: a 6-row code list: referenced by 2 table(s), references none, 3 or fewer simple columns.
export const language = defineTable("language", {
    columns: {
        languageId: col.serial().primaryKey(),
        name: col.text().notNull(),
        lastUpdate: col.timestamptz().notNull().onCreateNow()
    },
    relations: {
        film: rel.hasMany(() => film),
        film_by_original_language_id: rel.hasMany(() => film, { foreignKey: "original_language_id" })
    },
    rls: "admin-only"
});
